channel.title: The Equestrian Journal — Velvet & Valor
channel.description: Gift guides for horse lovers, equestrian lifestyle, and craft heritage from Velvet & Valor.

item.title: How to Ride a Horse: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: <From your very first lesson to your first rising trot, this definitive beginner's guide covers everything you need to know about how to ride a horse — with honest advice on costs, safety, and the confidence it takes to truly connect with your horse.>

item.title: How to Clean a Phone Case (Clear, Silicone & More)
item.description: Clear phone cases attract grime faster than you'd expect—and yellowing is often permanent. Here's exactly how to clean every type, and what actually works.

item.title: How to Clean a Silicone Phone Case
item.description: Silicone cases trap grime faster than almost any other material. Here is every method you need to keep yours spotless — and to know when it is time for something better.

item.title: What Is a MagSafe Case?
item.description: MagSafe cases promise effortless charging and snap-on accessories — but what exactly makes one work, and how do you choose well? Everything you need to know, explained clearly.

item.title: Why Do Clear Cases Turn Yellow? (And How to Prevent It)
item.description: Clear phone cases turn yellow through a well-understood chemical process — but not all materials age the same way. Here's what's actually happening, and what you can do about it.

item.title: What Is MagSafe? Everything Explained
item.description: MagSafe is Apple's ring of built-in magnets that snaps accessories and chargers precisely into place on your iPhone. Here's everything you need to know, from how it works to choosing the right case.

item.title: Equestrian Terms: The Complete Glossary
item.description: From your first rising trot to the finer points of collection in Grand Prix dressage, the language of equestrianism is rich, precise, and deeply rewarding to learn. This complete glossary covers every equestrian term you are likely to encounter, whatever your discipline or level.

item.title: Girl Horse Names: 200+ Ideas
item.description: <Choosing the right girl horse name is one of the most personal decisions a horse owner makes. This guide covers 200+ names across every style, with the meaning and story behind each.>

item.title: What Does "Equestrian" Actually Mean?
item.description: "Equestrian" runs far deeper than a riding style or a fashion aesthetic — it's a word with 2,000 years of history that still shapes how we live, compete, and connect with horses today. Here's everything it truly means.

item.title: What Is a "Horse Girl"? (And Why We're Reclaiming It)
item.description: The phrase "horse girl" carries more nuance than any meme gives it credit for. Here's the full story — from its origins to why equestrians everywhere are reclaiming it with pride.
